patterns.note: Alternating full-bleed editorial imagery with structured product grids (typically 3-column or 2-column) to create visual rhythm and highlight different content types.
A strong typographic hierarchy featuring a distinctive serif logo, bold sans-serif headings, and smaller, often uppercase, sans-serif labels for categories and calls to action.
A high-contrast palette of black and white/light gray is consistently used for backgrounds and text, punctuated by a rich, deep red accent for interactive elements and brand highlights.
The hero image exhibits a subtle parallax effect, moving slower than the foreground content as the user scrolls down the page.
The primary navigation bar remains sticky at the top of the viewport, maintaining accessibility to key links throughout the scroll.

Content sections are clearly delineated by generous vertical spacing and often by alternating background colors (white and light gray), creating distinct visual blocks for different product categories or brand stories.

technique_notes: The hero section employs a background image that scrolls at a slower rate than the foreground content, creating a depth-of-field parallax effect.
Content sections below the hero likely reveal with a subtle fade-up or slide-up animation as they enter the viewport, using CSS keyframes to trigger the transitions.
The main navigation bar is fixed to the top of the browser window, ensuring it remains visible and accessible as the user scrolls down the page.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) provide strong visual anchors, complemented by smaller, often uppercase, sans-serif labels and a clean, legible body text.
design_tokens.radius: Predominantly sharp corners on most elements, with very subtle rounding on interactive components like buttons and input fields.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing between major content sections to create a sense of luxury and allow imagery to breathe, while product grids maintain a more compact density.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its sophisticated blend of high-contrast black and white editorial photography with rich, vibrant product imagery. This creates a luxurious and aspirational brand experience that feels more like an art gallery or high-fashion editorial than a typical e-commerce site, effectively elevating the perception of the products.
